baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional إن مكناهم, the two uses of ء م ر, and the closing ولله عاقبة الأمور bracket human action between granted capacity and an outcome owned by God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Empowerment is a conditional grant that creates custodial responsibility. إقامة activates maintenance and care, while the shift from commanding to the totality of affairs prevents the empowered group from treating its command as ultimate sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The capacity-and-empowerment branch makes rule a granted ability and the condition of the test.
The care, preservation, and governance branch turns إقامة into sustained custodianship rather than one ritual gesture.
The authority-holder branch gives public force to commanding while keeping that force inside a delegated office.
The affairs-and-condition branch widens the final occurrence from one command to the whole field whose outcome escapes human ownership.
The last-part and outcome branch supplies the terminal audit that limits the preceding exercise of authority.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists the conduct of rulers after they gain power.
changed_reading.after: The ayah tests recipients of a conditional grant: they must maintain worship, provision, and public restraint while knowing that neither authority nor its outcome belongs to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four coordinated perfect verbs أقاموا, آتوا, أمروا, and نهوا form the response to one condition of empowerment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The actions work as a coupled maintenance system: worship supplies orientation, giving makes resources move, zakat produces growth and repair, recognized good gives positive direction, and prohibition provides a stopping boundary against publicly deforming conduct.

activation_trace.role: The support, subsistence, and system branch makes إقامة the load-bearing maintenance of communal life.
The specified-worship branch anchors one component in recurrent embodied prayer rather than generic policy.
The giving branch supplies an outward transfer, making provision a performed movement rather than an attitude.
The growth-and-increase branch makes redistribution productive of renewed communal capacity.
The purification-and-repair branch adds a corrective function to the same transfer without displacing its growth function.
The good recognized by self, reason, and norm gives public positive direction to the system.
The rebuke-and-restraint branch supplies an active boundary against harmful action.
The repelled ugly branch identifies the negative pole as conduct requiring resistance, not merely private dislike.

changed_reading.before: Prayer, zakat, commanding good, and forbidding wrong are four adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: They are interdependent public infrastructure: orientation, circulation, constructive norm formation, and restraint must remain coupled for empowerment to count as sound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposition between المعروف and المنكر is built from recognition and non-recognition, and it sits between human command and God's ownership of the outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: Public moral action requires discernment rather than bare assertion. Recognition follows signs, consultation manages judgment, reason restrains the ugly, and review remains possible because what appears unfamiliar or objectionable can reflect either real deformation or failed recognition.

activation_trace.role: The consultation-and-deliberation branch makes command a reasoned public process rather than an isolated fiat.
Recognition after a trace or sign makes the positive norm evidentially discoverable rather than self-certifying.
The contrary-to-recognition branch preserves the epistemic gap between what is known and what is denied or unrecognized.
The change into something unknown or disliked keeps open the possibility that estrangement itself shapes the negative judgment.
The intellect-that-restrains branch makes prohibition depend on disciplined judgment as well as coercive stopping.
The review-and-reconsideration branch makes moral administration answerable to later examination.

changed_reading.before: The empowered group applies already obvious labels of good and evil.
changed_reading.after: The empowered group must sustain a corrigible practice of recognition, deliberation, restraint, and review while refusing to make its own recognition final.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence identifies the prospective empowered as people attacked, wronged, and expelled, then frames defensive permission as دفع that prevents demolition of multiple kinds of worship space. Their later power is therefore restorative counterpower whose first logic is protection from dispossession and destruction.

activation_trace.role: Granted capacity anchors the contextual defense reading back in the conditional empowerment of the focus ayah.
Care and preservation make the empowered response one of maintaining what violence threatened.
The permission branch marks force as licensed in response to a stated condition, not self-authorizing expansion.
Withholding or confining a right supplies the concrete injustice to which permission responds.
Vindication of the wronged makes aid restorative rather than a prize for dominance.
Passage forcibly outside a place supplies displacement as the social injury preceding empowerment.
Pushing away harm gives reciprocal force a protective and limiting function.
The building-collapse branch identifies the institutional destruction that defensive power averts.
The worship-place branch extends the protected field beyond one group's ritual building to a plurality of sites.

structural_cues: The relative الذين in 22:41 immediately follows the الذين أخرجوا description in 22:40.
The sequence runs permission after injustice, prevention of demolished worship sites, conditional empowerment, then public duties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attack, injustice, expulsion, defensive pushing, threatened worship sites, and then conditional empowerment; I infer that protection and restoration define the purpose of the later power. A live alternative is that 22:40 justifies defense generally without specifying every later institution.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a generic program for any successful religious government.
changed_reading.after: The ayah first describes post-dispossession trusteeship: power is legitimate as bounded protection that restores rights and keeps diverse worship spaces from being destroyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equal access to the sanctuary, repeated commands to feed, explicit need, and a recipient who can be read as either content or asking turn zakat into reachable provision. The contrast between what does not reach God and protective orientation that does shifts ritual value away from display and toward socially delivered care.

activation_trace.role: Actual giving anchors the contextual feeding sequence in the focus ayah's required transfer.
Growth makes the transfer answerable to whether recipients and communal capacity can flourish.
Equality between two parties makes access, resident and visitor alike, part of the distributive field.
Feeding another supplies the concrete outward destination of ritual provision.
Material need identifies the vulnerable recipient rather than leaving giving socially indeterminate.
Contentment preserves the recipient who does not press a claim as a proper object of provision.
The asking branch preserves the coexisting reading of an explicit petitioner, widening rather than resolving the recipient profile.
Reaching supplies the contrast between external sacrificial matter that does not arrive and orientation that does.
Protection from harm gives taqwa a practical orientation that disciplines the handling of provision.

structural_cues: 22:28 and 22:36 repeat the imperative to eat and feed, naming poor, content, and asking recipients.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with taqwa through the repeated verb of reaching.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equality of access, concrete feeding, named need, plural recipient postures, and a reach/non-reach contrast; I infer that zakat in 22:41 is measured by delivered care rather than ceremonial transfer. A live alternative is that these are pilgrimage distributions that only analogically inform zakat.

changed_reading.before: Giving zakat is a badge accompanying established worship.
changed_reading.after: Giving zakat is the circulation arm of worship: provision must cross social distance, reach both visible and quiet need, and produce protected communal growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated delay is followed by a settlement whose roofs collapse while its well is disabled and its fortified palace remains as a monument. Travel and heart-reason turn this landscape into an audit: the عاقبة of affairs is legible in whether life-supporting systems remain inhabited and usable, not in impressive construction alone.

activation_trace.role: The terminal-outcome branch anchors the ruined landscape as one possible historical disclosure of consequence.
The affairs branch makes the material audit bear on the whole managed condition, not only isolated commands.
Extended time and respite separate present power from its eventual assessment.
Collapse and falling make failed order physically visible in the settlement.
The well supplies the ordinary life-supporting infrastructure against which monumental success is tested.
Emptiness and disabling turn the well from an asset into evidence of social abandonment.
The raised and fortified building supplies durable prestige that can coexist with failed communal life.
Movement through the land makes consequences observable rather than merely asserted.
Reason that restrains ignorance converts the observed ruins into institutional learning.
Repeated respite confirms that delay is part of the mechanism and is not evidence of a favorable outcome.

structural_cues: 22:45 juxtaposes collapsed habitation, a disabled well, and a fortified palace.
22:44 and 22:48 repeat divine respite around the invitation in 22:46 to travel and reason with hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed seizure, ruined habitation, an idle well, an impressive palace, travel, and reasoning; I infer that the contrast audits provisioning against prestige. A live alternative is that the images signify destruction generally rather than a specific critique of institutional priorities.

changed_reading.before: God's ownership of the outcome refers only to a remote final verdict.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing final judgment, the outcome also leaves delayed historical evidence: a polity can preserve monuments while losing the wells and inhabited life that reveal whether its duties worked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of material being cast into communication, removed and replaced, then made secure presents truth-bearing as an error-correcting process. Its assay reveals disequilibrium and hardened hearts, while receptive hearts become low and settled; this revises المعروف والمنكر into norms requiring correction, testing, and humility.

activation_trace.role: Recognition after a sign anchors the contextual correction sequence in the focus ayah's positive norm.
Transformation into the unknown or disliked makes failed recognition a live risk in naming the negative norm.
Reason that restrains ugly action makes disciplined discernment part of prohibition.
Casting something into a field supplies the intrusive input that the correction mechanism must expose.
Deviation, crookedness, and severity characterize the contaminating input without making it an independent theme.
Removal followed by replacement supplies explicit correction rather than mere suppression.
Securing and making firm supplies the stabilization phase after correction.
Assaying metal or persons makes disturbance diagnostically reveal the quality of receivers.
Departure from health and balance identifies one failure mode in receiving and judging a message.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies a second, resistant failure mode.
Low, wide, settled ground gives receptive humility a spatial counterimage to hardened resistance.

structural_cues: 22:52 repeats يلقي around the ordered sequence ينسخ ثم يحكم.
22:53-54 contrasts diseased or hard hearts with hearts that settle humbly after knowing the truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intrusion, removal-with-replacement, securing, assay, and contrasting heart conditions; I infer an analogy from protected revelation to corrigible civic discernment. The materially live alternative is that this correction sequence is unique to prophetic communication and should not be generalized into a governance procedure.

changed_reading.before: Commanding recognized good means enforcing a fixed inventory whose application is transparent.
changed_reading.after: Commanding good and forbidding wrong also require error correction: claims must be tested, contamination removed, judgments secured, and the judging heart kept receptive rather than hardened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root as عاقبة becomes reciprocal punishment, immediately measured by equivalence; renewed aggression then draws aid, yet the sequence closes with pardon and protective covering. Forbidding wrong is thus calibrated intervention with an off-ramp, not an unlimited mandate to escalate.

activation_trace.role: Active restraint anchors proportional response in the focus ayah's duty to stop harm.
The combat-and-hostility branch exposes the escalation risk latent in opposing wrong.
Punishment following an offense activates consequence as reciprocal response rather than only final outcome.
Likeness and equivalence set a measure on the response.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies the renewed violation that warrants aid.
Vindication of the wronged directs aid toward restoration rather than retaliatory surplus.
Leaving punishment and erasing the offense supplies a genuine exit from the punitive cycle.
Covering the offense while protecting its bearer from the residue supplies restorative closure.

structural_cues: 22:60 uses reciprocal morphology and بِمِثْلِ before naming a second act of aggression.
The verse moves from measured response and promised aid to the paired attributes عفو and غفور.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal punishment, explicit equivalence, transgression, aid, pardon, and covering; I infer that the public restraint of 22:41 should be proportionate and designed to terminate retaliation. A live alternative is that 22:60 governs an individual victim's response and only indirectly constrains institutions.

changed_reading.before: Forbidding wrong licenses suppression until the wrong disappears.
changed_reading.after: Forbidding wrong is bounded by equivalence, protection of the wronged, and a real path from coercive response into pardon and repaired safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispute over ritual affairs is routed toward invitation and deferred judgment; later, opponents visibly register المنكر and nearly assault reciters. The recurrence demonstrates that felt or facial recognition can be partisan and violent, so the focus pair cannot be reduced to factional familiarity and disgust.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a trace anchors the delta in the focus ayah's claim that good must be knowable through evidence.
Non-recognition supplies the unstable negative pole whose recurrence in hostile faces tests the baseline.
Mutual pulling between two sides makes ritual difference an active contest rather than a settled classification.
The affairs branch connects that contest directly to the same semantic field as the focus ayah's commands and affairs.
Judgment between people places final resolution of the dispute outside immediate factional coercion.
Each party taking a different path preserves genuine disagreement instead of pretending recognition is uniform.
Recognition from a visible sign reappears on faces, but now as a prelude to hostile misclassification.
Something rendered unfamiliar or disliked shows how estrangement can be experienced as wrongness.
Nearness to performing an act turns hostile recognition into an imminent behavioral danger.
The split root's fighting branch keeps an exploratory combat image alive beside the dominant near-action reading.

structural_cues: The branchless س ط و occurrence at 22:72 word 13 supplies imminent assault structurally and is not assigned an invented branch.
22:67-69 routes contest through دعوتك إلى ربك, divine knowledge, and later judgment before 22:72 stages violent face-reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual dispute, deferred judgment, facial recognition of munkar, near-action, and branchless assault; I infer that immediate disgust can masquerade as moral recognition and therefore cannot alone authorize coercion. A live alternative is that تعرف المنكر narrates the narrator's accurate reading of their expression, not the opponents' own moral classification.

changed_reading.before: Whatever a community readily recognizes as good or repellent can be directly enforced by those in power.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is contested and can become a pretext for assault; public command therefore needs evidence, invitation, restraint, and humility before the judgment the group does not own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly scene defeats totalized agency: even gathered force cannot create a small life or extract what it takes, and seeker and sought are both weak. Conditional empowerment in the focus ayah therefore grants actionable capacity without granting comprehensive control.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and empowerment anchor the later inability scene as a limit on granted human efficacy.
Public authority supplies the institutional actor whose competence must not be mistaken for sovereignty.
The literal fly supplies the deliberately small agent that exposes disproportionate human inability.
Restless and wavering movement explains why the apparently minor agent remains hard to master.
Gathering force until its parts cohere maximizes collective capacity before the stated failure.
Extraction from another's grasp supplies the precise recovery operation that remains beyond the actors.
The contrary-to-strength branch names limitation on both sides of the pursuit.
Claiming and exacting a right sharpens the failure as inability to recover even what is treated as due.

structural_cues: 22:73 sets ولو اجتمعوا against لن يخلقوا and لا يستنقذوه.
The branchless س ل ب occurrence at word 20 supplies seizure structurally, while شيء at word 22 minimizes what cannot be recovered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered capacity, a small seizing agent, failed extraction, and paired weakness; I infer a warning against reading تمكين as total administrative mastery. A live alternative is that the scene targets worship of powerless objects and bears on political power only by analogy.

changed_reading.before: Once empowered, the group possesses the efficacy needed to order society through its commands.
changed_reading.after: Empowerment supplies a bounded tool, not mastery: institutions remain unable to create, control, or recover everything and must govern with acknowledged fragility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement says that affairs return to God, broadens responsibility into reciprocal witnessing, repeats إقامة الصلاة and إيتاء الزكاة almost verbatim, and adds holding fast. This turns the focus profile from a ruler-only platform into a community-wide witness practice whose cohesion and final reference remain external to its own power.

activation_trace.role: The final-outcome branch anchors the closure's explicit return of affairs in the focus ayah.
Return and restoration make explicit the direction only implied by the focus ayah's outcome.
The affairs branch creates a direct lexical reprise: the entire managed field returns to God.
Presence with witnessing recasts public moral work as accountable testimony rather than ownership.
Knowledgeable declaration gives the witness role an evidential, communicative function.
The repeated imperative to maintain and preserve prayer extends custodianship to the addressed community.
The exact worship recurrence ties the closing communal vocation to the focus ayah's first practice.
Repeated giving confirms outward transfer as part of the shared witness vocation.
Repeated growth links the community's provision to durable flourishing rather than a one-time payment.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies cohesion without making the community self-sufficient.

structural_cues: 22:76 restates the focus ending as وإلى الله ترجع الأمور.
22:78 shifts to direct plural address, names reciprocal witness, and repeats فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct return-of-affairs reprise, reciprocal witnessing, exact repetition of prayer and zakat, and holding fast; I infer that 22:41's governance profile also belongs to a broader communal witness office. A live alternative is that the closure reiterates shared duties without changing the narrower political referent of 22:41.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah assigns a distinctive checklist to a future ruling class.
changed_reading.after: The focus ayah concentrates a community-wide vocation of accountable witness: empowered office intensifies duties shared by the believers, while all affairs return beyond them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant watercourse, fertile-ground, growth, and terminal-basin branches rather than ordinary lexical glosses. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in آتوا, الزكاة, الأرض, أقاموا, and نهوا and is reinforced by the packet's water-to-green-earth sequence. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory hydraulic model, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places granted capacity in الأرض and coordinates maintaining, giving, growth, and setting a prohibition boundary.

activation_trace.role: Soft germinating ground turns the land from neutral territory into a substrate whose response can be cultivated.
Support, subsistence, and system supply the sustaining structure of the cultivation analogy.
A watercourse and the opening of its path recast giving as directed flow through public channels.
Increase and growth supply the intended yield of the directed flow.
A basin at the end of a flood gives prohibition the analogical role of a boundary that catches destructive overflow.
Delivering water by irrigation supplies the contextual flow that activates the focus ayah's channel image.
The repeated fertile-ground branch links the land of empowerment to a visible capacity for renewed life.
Fresh green growth supplies the observable output by which the social irrigation analogy is judged.

changed_reading.before: The earth is simply the jurisdiction in which empowered people perform duties.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the earth is a social growing medium: authority must maintain channels that move provision into growth while boundaries catch destructive overflow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the race image of the second horse following the leader from the prayer root. It remains anchored in الصلاة and in the immediate order from wronged defenders and protected worship sites to إقامة الصلاة. Downstream prose should present only the sequencing analogy: protection leads and public ritual follows; it must not claim that the branch is the lexical sense of prayer here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Prayer is the first named practice after conditional empowerment, but the preceding context has already staged defense of victims and worship places.

activation_trace.role: The horse following the leader supplies an analogical sequence in which established prayer comes behind prior protective justice.
A right withheld identifies the victim-centered condition that leads the sequence.
Protective pushing supplies the action that precedes and enables secure public worship.
Threatened building collapse makes protection of institutions concrete rather than ceremonial.
Worship places identify what protective justice keeps standing before the empowered establish their own prayer.

changed_reading.before: Established prayer heads the empowered group's platform and independently legitimates it.
changed_reading.after: In the exploratory race sequence, ritual follows protection: prayer cannot substitute for defending the wronged and keeping worship spaces standing.

strongest_changes: Immediate context revises empowerment into restorative counterpower for people wronged and expelled, bounded by protection of plural worship space.
Prayer and zakat become coupled public maintenance and socially delivered provision rather than status badges.
The recurrence of recognition and munkar in a scene of imminent assault makes moral recognition contested and demands corrigibility and restraint.
The outcome of affairs gains both a delayed material audit in ruined settlements and an explicit return to God in the closing reprise.
The final repetition broadens the focus profile into a community-wide vocation of accountable witness while preserving the special burden of empowered office.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by two reversals: human command is enclosed by God's grant and God's ownership of affairs, and apparently straightforward recognition of good and wrong is later destabilized by hostile face-reading. Material branches also kept live coexisting models of cultivation, provisioning, ruined infrastructure, bounded force, and fragile efficacy.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate الذين link strongly favors the expelled defenders as antecedent, but the ayah may also state a wider type of legitimate empowerment.
The error-correction sequence is explicitly about protected revelation; its extension to civic discernment remains analogical.
The hydraulic and race-sequence outliers are branch-backed material analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.
